# ais fixtures

Inventory fetch and AIS: the decisions `AISUpdate` and the background fetch
take on each response, and the requests they send to a mock AIS and
capability server.

Filled by recorder R3 of the inventory rung (vkstorm-rust rung seven). The
fixtures are recorded from the unmodified viewer C++, before any port commit,
on Windows and Linux, and are never edited by hand. To change them, change the
recorder and record them again.
